name: HH regime-switch 05 — realized-vol EXPANSION momentum, breakout via range_position (1h)
rationale: MECHANISM (distinct from variant 04: it detects the directional break via range_position at the TOP of the band, uses bb_width expansion as the regime gauge instead of vol_realized, and runs on a fast 1h clock to catch the breakout bar early): in a volatility EXPANSION regime the tell is the Bollinger band physically widening (bb_width above a fitted floor) as price pushes to the upper edge of its range (range_position high) — that is a real breakout with directional order flow, not a mid-range wiggle. Trading it on 1h captures the persistence before slow institutions finish repricing. Exit: bb_width contracts back (the expansion regime is over) or ADX collapses, or stop/TP/time. This is a distinct read of the SAME expansion state as 04 (band geometry vs realized vol), so if they produce identical trades they are the same spec. DISCONFIRMER: the breakout edge must clear the Gate net of fees in the expansion (wide-band) regime specifically; if bb_width adds no information beyond variant 04's vol_realized (their trade sets overlap and net Sharpes match), collapse them. Kill if the 1h version's fees eat the entire edge — expansion breakouts are fee-hungry.
catalyst: band expansion with price breaking to the top of its range — directional expansion flow
